messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@harborhotels.com>, Ops Shuttle <ops@shuttleco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidate blocks & finalize buddy assignments for SF workshop

Hi Sara + Ops team,

Thanks again for the proposal. Quick ask: we have 78 attendees spread across two nearby properties in the initial plan — can Harbor consolidate our group into a single-block at the Harbor Grand (closest to the venue) while preserving our negotiated rate tiers? Consolidation would reduce shuttle rotations and make drop-offs simpler for late arrivals.

What we need to confirm by EOD Friday:
- Block consolidation feasibility and any incremental attrition penalties
- Do-not-disturb/quiet-floor options for 10 execs (list attached)
- Early check-in for ~12 guests arriving before 11:00am (subject to availability)
- 2 ADA-accessible rooms and one roll-in shower room
- Master bill flow and split by cost center (we can provide billing codes)

Attached: guest_list_v3.csv (includes roommate/buddy preferences in column F). I noted where people have allergies or late-night constraints — please honor pairing where possible. Monica will feed an updated CSV if there are changes.

Sara — can you confirm a tentative block id and deadline to release unused rooms? Also, Ops Shuttle: if the block consolidates, we'll want to reduce rotations; can you provide a 30-minute frequency plan for peak check-in/out windows?

Goals: minimize guest transfers between properties, lock in a single master bill to simplify reconciliation, and keep VIPs on the same floor where possible.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
---
[Attachment: guest_list_v3.csv (CSV)]

From: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@harborhotels.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ops Shuttle <ops@shuttleco.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate blocks & finalize buddy assignments for SF workshop

Karthik — thanks for the clear ask. Good news: Harbor Grand can absorb your full group (78 rooms) from the secondary property given current availability for the week of Oct 12–15. Summary below: 

- Tentative Block ID: HG-4842 (hold until 2026-09-08)
- Rate tiers: Standard (single/double) at $279/night; Exec King at $349/night (VIPs)
- Early check-in: best-effort; we can guarantee 6 rooms for 9:00–11:00 arrival for a $35 early-arrival fee per room, remaining requests will be accommodated as rooms turn over
- Quiet floor: we can reserve one adjacent floor for the 10 execs; keys can be pre-programmed to restrict access to floor corridors
- ADA rooms: two confirmed (both near elevator); one roll-in shower set aside
- Master bill: Harbor will issue a primary master with sub-ledgers; we can split by PO or cost-center on reconciliation. I attached a sample master bill layout.

Notes/next steps:
1) Please confirm if you want all guest pickups to route to Harbor Grand only; Ops Shuttle, can you confirm pickup frequency options?
2) We need signed block confirmation by 2026-09-08 to hold HG-4842; after that the release policy reverts to the standard 30-day attrition schedule.
3) Please send the final rooming list 10 business days prior to arrival (we'll accept updates up to 48 hours out for emergency swaps).

Attachments: hotel_master_bill_example.pdf, block_policy_summary.pdf

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Bloom
Senior Sales Manager — Harbor Hotels

Sara — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming Harbor Grand only for pickups. We will sign the block confirmation by 2026-09-02 to be safe (sending to legal for quick review). A few clarifications: 

- We will take the 6 guaranteed early-checkin rooms at $35 each for the earliest arrivals; please add a note to the master that those fees go to our corporate card.
- Quiet-floor request: can you pre-program key access and supply a list of room numbers so we can align the VIPs in our sheet?
- For the ADA/roll-in room, please flag as 'blocked' and do not reassign unless we explicitly release it.

Marissa — FYI: pairing rules in the attached CSV are soft-preferences except for 4 strict pairings (parents traveling together + medical notes). Monica — I'll need the final cost-center codes for reconciliation (we have three PO numbers).

I'll attach a signed block confirmation once legal returns the doc.

Thanks,
Karthik
